description: Two plugins selected at once (a click on DLCRobot.esm and a Ctrl+click on DLCworkshop01.esm): "Undelete and Disable References" and "Remove Identical to Master records" each walk both file nodes in load order in one click, and the dirty information of a click is stored once, under the plugin and CRC32 of the last record the walk stored them for.
